name: solink
description: Solink — E2E encrypted chat that disguises messages as code (Boss Mode).

scripts.dev:e2e: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY= next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1
scripts.test:core: vitest run tests/crypto.test.ts tests/cloudInbox.test.ts tests/deviceKeyState.test.ts tests/deviceRegistry.test.ts tests/deviceLink.test.ts tests/envelope.test.ts tests/encryptedOutbox.test.ts tests/supabaseTransport.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
